title: Prepare yourselves mentally, things are changing and probably about to happen. I hope I haven’t waited to long to post this. PLEASE READ ⬇️⬇️⬇️
content: It’s too soon to say if this is positive or negative but it could be either. Trust your intuition above all else. Trust only your senses and FACE TO FACE conversations with family, and to a lesser degree people you’ve known for a long time. Keep in mind the potential quantum entanglement of human brains as a species and the implications of that when paired with computer chips being introduced directly into the human biology, along with the advent of AI and quantum computing. Remember that fear is extremely counterproductive and unhelpful at this point. Take any information obtained through technology with a massive tablespoon of salt, even this. Your own internal emotional state is more important than you could possibly imagine, do not let it be manipulated. Learn to maintain a constant state of unconditional love without sacrificing your rational mind. Go to a PHYSICAL BOOK STORE to learn these meditative techniques and minimize your reliance on technology in any way that you can. “Do not give into astonishment” -Terence Mckenna This is absolutely critical advise, and will become even more so as things progress. DESIDERATA
